local p=settings.panels.self_buffs
assert(settings.style.theme=='Original FFXI','Theme was not applied')
assert(settings.style.font=='Original FFXI','Font was not paired')
assert(settings.style.font_size==16,'Native text size was not applied')
assert(p.x==321 and p.y==222,'Placement was lost')
assert(p.filter=='Haste' and p.include[33] and p.exclude[40],'Filters were lost')
assert(p.bar_style=='rail' and p.bar_thickness==8 and not p.gradient,'Gauge style was not applied')
assert(next(p.colors)==nil,'Colors were not reset')
assert(type(settings.panels.future_panel)=='table' and settings.panels.future_panel.zz_newer==1,'Unknown settings were lost')
assert(require('ui.client_fonts').available('Original FFXI'),'Stock font unavailable')
assert(PREVIEW_PY.image_count()>0,'Native artwork was not drawn')
local history=PREVIEW.addon.callbacks.history_status()
assert(history.undo>0 and history.undo_label=='Skin: Original FFXI','Appearance undo checkpoint missing: '..tostring(history.undo_label))

local p=settings.panels.self_buffs
assert(require('core.store').equal(settings.style,PREVIEW.original_style),'Undo did not restore the whole appearance')
assert(settings.style.minimal,'Undo lost Minimal')
assert(p.x==321 and p.y==222,'Undo lost placement')
assert(p.filter=='Haste' and p.include[33] and p.exclude[40],'Undo lost filters')
assert(p.gradient and p.colors.label[2]==0.4,'Undo did not restore panel overrides')
assert(type(settings.panels.future_panel)=='table' and settings.panels.future_panel.zz_newer==1,'Undo lost unknown settings')
assert(PREVIEW.addon.callbacks.history_status().redo>0,'Undo was not captured for redo')
